basics.description: Creates, in **your** subscription, what Runtm needs to run sandboxes there: a resource group, a broker managed identity that trusts your organization's Runtm Google identity (no secret), a sandbox group, a container registry, a storage account for workspace layers, and the role assignments between them. Nothing grants Runtm access outside that resource group. Copy the **Runtm organization id** and **Resource slug** below from the Runtm dialog; everything else derives from them. You need **Owner** (or Contributor + User Access Administrator) on the subscription.

validations.message: You need Owner, or Contributor plus User Access Administrator, on the subscription: the template creates role assignments and a resource lock.
You need permission to create a resource group in this subscription.

location.label: Region
location.toolTip: Every resource is created here. Only regions that offer Container Apps Sandboxes are listed. One deployment per region.

elements.name: organizationId
elements.label: Runtm organization id
elements.toolTip: Shown in Runtm under Integrations -> Azure Sandboxes (copy it from there). Every resource name and the token audience derive from it.

elements.name: tenantSlug
elements.label: Resource slug
elements.toolTip: First 12 hex characters of sha256(organization id); every resource name carries it, the same as on AWS. Copy it from the Runtm dialog.

elements.name: suffix
elements.label: Suffix (optional label)
elements.toolTip: Human-readable label in front of the slug, e.g. pci or ops: resource group runtm-sandbox-pci-<slug>-<region>, sandbox group rtm-pci-<slug>. 1-10 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens (the same cap as the AWS stack). Enter the same value in the Runtm dialog.

constraints.validationMessage: 1-10 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens, starting and ending with a letter or digit.

elements.name: sessionArtifactRetentionDays
elements.label: Paused-session layer retention (days)
elements.toolTip: Days to keep paused-session workspace layers (sessions/). Matches Runtm's paused-session retention.

elements.name: templateVersionRetentionDays
elements.label: Superseded template golden retention (days)
elements.toolTip: Template goldens never expire; previous versions are purged after this many days.

elements.name: createVnet
elements.label: Create a VNet and connect the sandbox group to it (sandboxes can then reach private databases on your network)
elements.toolTip: Creates a VNet with one subnet delegated to Microsoft.App/environments and a vnetConnections child on the sandbox group. The subnet cannot be changed afterwards.

elements.name: subnetCidr
elements.label: Delegated subnet
elements.toolTip: Subnet inside the VNet that sandboxes attach to. Keep at least a /23.
